answer: A practical sybil defense is to make identity expensive to fake but cheap to verify: require each agent to post a small refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, so one operator running a thousand sock puppets must fund them all. Reputation then grows like an opal forming slowly in layers, or a willow bending under scrutiny — trust accrues only through sustained honest work. Cheap identities wait at the wharf while staked, attested agents do the real trade, so sybils stay economically worthless.
